{{Quote|Ki Sazen saved my people. She was only a Padawan when she came to Tas-La and slew the Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu.|The Nikto [[Chevuk]] mentions the spine dragon that Ki Sazen killed|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The cult of Ki Sazen|Taris}}</ref>}}
'''Spine dragons''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] animals that were indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. One dragon known as the [[Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu]] lived on the planet [[Tas-La]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] until the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ki Sazen]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the creature. The species was considered dangerous; however, the sentient [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] species, who also dwelt on Kintan, eventually drove the spine dragons to extinction.

==Biology and appearance==
Spine dragons were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of animals.<ref name="GG12" />

==History==
Spine dragons were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]],<ref name="GG12" /> which was located in the [[Kintan system/Legends|Kintan system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> within the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. When the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[M'dweshuu]] at the heart of the Si'Klaata cluster went [[Nova/Legends|nova]], it released a large dose of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] that reached Kintan. That caused [[Mutant|mutation]] in the planet's indigenous species, and over thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]], it resulted in the evolution of the spine dragons.<ref name="GG12" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ki Sazen]] slew a spine dragon known as the [[Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu]] on the planet [[Tas-La]], which led to a [[Cult of Ki Sazen|Nikto cult]] forming around her.<ref name="TOR" /> The species was considered reasonably dangerous and was driven to [[Death/Legends|extinction]] by the sentient [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] species, who were also native to Kintan.<ref name="GATORN">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' states that the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] drove all life on [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] to [[Death/Legends|extinction]] except flora and smaller, non-threatening [[Species/Legends|species]]. Due to their description as dangerous creatures, this article assumes that spine dragons were among those driven to extinction.</ref> Spine dragons were later popularized throughout the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], by [[holo-serial]]s created by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|Xenoarchaeologist]] [[Henrietya Antilles]], better known as "Corellia Antilles."<ref name="GATOR">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Spine dragons were first mentioned in [[1995]] in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a supplement book in the ''[[Galaxy Guide]]'' series for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', a [[roleplaying game]] released by [[West End Games]]. The species was mentioned in the entry for the Nikto, which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="GG12" />
